commands: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --prune origin ui/radar-details-redesign; git checkout ui/radar-details-redesign; git merge --ff-only origin/ui/radar-details-redesign; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 'dbf91226688f98151f75c20f742079981bcadd41'; echo P1_HEAD_VERIFIED

set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p1-real-radar-v3"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys gfxinfo io.blueeye reset >/dev/null || true; SIZE=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell wm size | tail -n1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+x[0-9]+' | tail -n1); W=${SIZE%x*}; H=${SIZE#*x}; X=$((W/2)); Y1=$((H*78/100)); Y2=$((H*32/100)); for i in $(seq 1 8); do $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe $X $Y1 $X $Y2 240 >/dev/null; sleep 0.12; done; for i in $(seq 1 8); do $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input swipe $X $Y2 $X $Y1 240 >/dev/null; sleep 0.12; done; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys gfxinfo io.blueeye > "$OUT/gfxinfo.txt"; grep -E 'Total frames rendered|Janky frames|50th percentile|90th percentile|95th percentile|99th percentile' "$OUT/gfxinfo.txt"; FRAMES=$(grep 'Total frames rendered:' "$OUT/gfxinfo.txt" | head -n1 | awk '{print $4}'); test "${FRAMES:-0}" -gt 0; PID=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell logcat -d --pid="$PID" -t 1200 > "$OUT/logcat-tail.txt"; ! grep -Eq 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime: FATAL|OutOfMemoryError|SQLiteException|SecurityException' "$OUT/logcat-tail.txt"; echo P1_REAL_GFXINFO_LOGCHECK_PASS; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
